notes.title: Update information(3/5)
notes.content:
We had updated "Battle Crust" to V.1.02.
Input bug of particular controller(such as HORI Fighting Stick EX2 for XBOX360) was fixed.
Please confirm.

In "OPTION", you can find "1.02".  If it is "1.01", please restart your Steam client.

"Battle Crust" has been updated.
I had received the bug reports of joystick.
But my controllers have no bug from the previous in this game.
